project.title: Temporal variation in air-purifier filter-associated bacterial communities in residential living rooms and bedrooms
project.description: This study investigates temporal variations in indoor bacterial communities associated with air-purifier filters across residential spaces. By sampling living rooms and bedrooms in homes across Japan over three consecutive time periods, we aimed to evaluate how bacterial diversity and community composition change across rooms and over time, alongside indoor microclimate variables like temperature and humidity. Characterized via 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing, this work provides key insights into indoor microbiome dynamics, highlighting the critical importance of accounting for temporal sampling periods when evaluating residential air quality and microbial exposure.
